params.body:
Version 8 of the did:webvh log adds `#agent-workbench`: the Ed25519 key of the session on the operator's machine that proposes through the control gateway (elixir#157). From this version a stranger can trace a record of the workbench, whose submitter signature the gateway verifies against this key, to the identity of Above Beyond. What the workbench may do stays the grant: push and open, never merge.

Signed on the YubiKey by the operator on 2026-09-12; `node scripts/did-webvh.mjs verify` resolves the log. The did:web document is derived from the same state.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench, which is fitting.
params.title: did:webvh version 8: #agent-workbench
